title: 2026 Filing Season: Preliminary Observations on IRS Performance
summary:
What GAO Found

The Internal Revenue Service’s (IRS) overall processing performance during the 2026 filing season was similar to 2025. IRS processed about 98 percent of the 177 million individual and business returns that it received during the 2026 filing season—the same percentage as last year.
